title: Executive at Global Professional Services Firm Expects CrowdStrike Business to Be Steady Near-Term and Grow in 2026
expert: Integrator at a global professional services firm (current; endpoint/threat detection 20%–25% of their work)
verdict: CrowdStrike-related business at the expert's firm grew 5%–10% y/y in Aug–Oct, slightly ahead of plan on license expansion and competitive switches, but they expect less than 5% in Nov–Jan on budget caution.

NNARR vs bogey (channel growth): CrowdStrike business +5%–10% y/y (Aug–Oct), well below the 30%+ partner growth in Aug channel checks (SB #43076). → Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR) ↓
less than 5% growth expected Nov–Jan (estimate) on year-end budget caution; first read on a slowdown. → Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR) ↓
Flex utilization: ~40% of deals on Flex, closure rates up ~10% vs Bernstein's "nearly all contracts Flex" (SB #66649): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR) →
FY29 model / margins: renewal spend +5%–10% y/y via added licenses, consistent with 100% Flex-cohort renewal (SB #44215). → Tenet 5 (margin/FCF) ↑
AIDR ARR conversion: AI risk-assessment programs see little traction as clients cannot measure ROI, vs Cleveland's board-level AIDR demand (SB #43077): conflicting. → Tenet 2 (AIDR cycle) ↓

changes: CRWD business +5%–10% y/y vs partners citing 30%+ growth in Aug (SB #43076): slower.
Flex in ~40% of deals vs Bernstein "nearly all contracts Flex since end of FY26" (SB #66649): conflicting.
Pricing / contract values up ~10% vs Bernstein 25–35% Flex discount on like-for-like SKUs (SB #66649): conflicting.
AI risk-assessment traction weak vs Cleveland board-level AIDR demand (SB #43077): conflicting.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR): ↓ — +5%–10% now, under 5% expected Nov–Jan; Flex ~40% of deals.
Tenet 2 (AIDR cycle): ↓ — AI risk-assessment programs have little traction; ROI hard to show.
Tenet 4 (core endpoint): ↑ — CRWD winning head-to-head vs SentinelOne; competitive switches drove the quarter.
Tenet 5 (margin/FCF): ↑ — pricing / contract values up ~10%, renewal spend +5%–10%.
